$comment: The entry pack's project IA (docs/project-ia.md). No marketing pages by design: Capture Data is a tool, not a pitch — the home route establishes a session (anonymous when nobody is signed in) and lands the user straight on /records with the entry form open (App.tsx homePageByPack.entry). siteName still brands the app shell. Records leads the destinations, so it is also the post-sign-in default.
